genius.notes: AUDF is an Australian AUD-backed non-cash payment product with a contractual 1:1 AUD redemption path for eligible Forte Account wholesale clients. Pharos found no token-specific U.S. GENIUS PPSI approval, state-qualified approval, official application, or registered foreign-issuer exception. The regime remains in proposed-rules phase as of 2026-08-14; Australian ASIC/AFSL and the Australian stablecoin distribution exemption are not GENIUS authorization.
